digest.component_or_area: Jira Cloud adapter - summary write and recovery
propositions: Each Cloud summary write invocation launches exactly one ACLI subprocess with proper process-group and child cleanup.
Summary recovery performs one REST request with no retry sleep (one-attempt policy), while all other REST callers retain the default three-attempt/2s-5s backoff policy unchanged.
Permanent failures (auth/TLS/permission) are classified distinctly from transient network/429/5xx outcomes and are not replayed locally.

Every terminal or exhausted outcome emits exactly one redacted completion log with bounded fields (logical id, disposition, counts, cleanup status, retry_not_before, capped message) and at most eight operation-diagnostics entries, each redacted before the 512-codepoint message cap.
